```{r setup}
load("../DATA/data1.Rdata")

  )
)
colnames = list(
  subid = "Subject", block = "Block", trial = "Trial",
  object = c("Object_1", "Object_2", "Object_3"),
  reward = c("Reward_1", "Reward_2", "Reward_3"),

)
```


## WM(test)

```{r}
dcay_wm <- function(
    value0, 
    values,
    reward,
    params,
    system,
    ...
){
  
  list2env(list(...), envir = environment())
  
  # If you need extra information(...)
  # Column names may be lost(C++), indexes are recommended
  # e.g.
  # Trial  <- idinfo[3]
  # Frame  <- exinfo[1]
  # Action <- behave[1]
  
  zeta       <-  params[["zeta"]]
  bonus      <-  params[["bonus"]]
  
  decay <- values + zeta * (value0 - values)

  return(decay)
}
```


```{r}
multiRL.model <- multiRL::run_m(
  data = data[data[, "Subject"] == 1, ],
  behrule = behrule,
  colnames = colnames,
  params = list(
    free = list(
      zeta = 0.1,
      beta = 0.5
    ),
    fixed = list(Q0 = 0.5, alpha = 1, weight = 1),
    constant = list(reset = 0.5)
  ),
  priors = list(),
  settings = list(
    name = "WM",
    mode = "fitting",
    estimate = "MLE",
    policy = "on",
    system = "WM"
  ),
  funcs = list(prob_func = prob_wm, dcay_func = dcay_wm)
)

multiRL.summary <- multiRL::summary(multiRL.model)
```

## WM(model)

```{r}
WM <- function(params){
  
  params <- list(
    free = list(
      zeta = params[1], beta = params[2]
    ),
    fixed = list(Q0 = 0.5, alpha = 1, weight = 1),
    constant = list(reset = 0.5)
  )

  multiRL.model <- multiRL::run_m(
    data = data,
    behrule = behrule,
    colnames = colnames,
    params = params,
    funcs = funcs,
    priors = priors,
    settings = settings
  )
  
  assign(x = "multiRL.model", value = multiRL.model, envir = multiRL.env)
  return(.return_result(multiRL.model))
}

```

## WM(recovery)

```{r}
reticulate::use_condaenv(condaenv = "tf-gpu", required = TRUE)
```

```{r}
recovery <- multiRL::rcv_d(
  estimate = "ABC",
  algorithm = "NLOPT_GN_MLSL",
  
  data = data,
  behrule = behrule,
  colnames = colnames,

  models = list(WM),
  priors = list(
    list(
      zeta = function(x) {stats::rbeta(n = 1, shape1 = 2, shape2 = 2)},
      beta = function(x) {stats::rexp(n = 1, rate = 1)}
    )
  ),
  settings = list(list(name = "WM", system = "WM")),
  funcs = list(list(dcay_func = dcay_wm)),
  
  lowers = list(c(0, 0)),
  uppers = list(c(1, 10)),
  control = list(
    core = 10, sample = 100, train = 1000,
    info = c("Object_1", "Object_2", "Object_3", "Action", "SetSize"),
    reduction = "PCA"
  )
)

save(recovery, file = "../OUTPUT/recovery.WM.Rdata")
```

```{r}
replay.recovery <- multiRL::rpl_e(
  result = recovery,

  data = data,
  behrule = behrule,
  colnames = colnames,
  
  models = list(WM),
  settings = list(list(name = "WM", system = "WM")),
  funcs = list(list(dcay_func = dcay_wm)),

  omit = c("data", "funcs")
)
  
save(replay.recovery, file = "../OUTPUT/replay.recovery.WM.Rdata")

p <- plot(x = replay.recovery)
ggplot2::ggsave(
  plot = p$param[[1]]$zeta, filename = "../WM_zeta.png",
  width = 5, height = 5
)
ggplot2::ggsave(
  plot = p$param[[1]]$beta, filename = "../WM_beta.png",
  width = 5, height = 5
)

rm(p)
```

```{r}
load("../OUTPUT/replay.fitting.WM.Rdata")

data_fitting <- base::do.call(
  base::rbind,
  base::lapply(
    replay.fitting[[1]],
    function(subject) {
      subject[["multiRL.summary"]]@data
    }
  )
) |>
  dplyr::select(
    Subject, SetSize, Stim_Count, Reward
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(Subject, SetSize, Stim_Count) |>
  dplyr::summarise(Acc = mean(Reward)) |>
  dplyr::ungroup()

# 计算每个 SetSize 在每个 Stim_Count 下的均值和标准误
data_fitting <- stats::aggregate(
  Acc ~ Stim_Count + SetSize,
  data = data_fitting,
  FUN = function(x) {
    c(mean = base::mean(x), se = stats::sd(x) / base::sqrt(base::length(x)))
  }
)

# 将 aggregate 的 matrix 结果展开为列
data_fitting <- base::do.call(base::data.frame, data_fitting)
base::colnames(data_fitting) <- c("Stim_Count", "SetSize", "Acc", "SE")
```

```{r}
ggplot2::ggplot(
  data = data_fitting,
  mapping = ggplot2::aes(
    x = Stim_Count,
    y = Acc,
    color = base::as.factor(SetSize),
    group = SetSize
  )
) +
  ggplot2::geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(size = 2) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:15) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  ggplot2::geom_errorbar(
    ggplot2::aes(ymin = Acc - SE, ymax = Acc + SE),
    width = 0.2
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    x = "Iteration (Stim_Count)",
    y = "Accuracy (Acc)",
    color = "Set Size"
  ) +
  papaja::theme_apa()

ggplot2::ggsave(filename = "../Exp_Effect_WM.png", width = 8, height = 6)
```
